perceptual_protocol.dhash: 64 comparisons right greater than left on gray9x8 INTER_AREA
perceptual_protocol.flag_heuristic: gray std both>=8; phash distance<=6 AND dhash<=8 AND mean RGB absolute difference<=12 on 8bit scale; these are predeclared triage heuristics, not validated duplicate-detector thresholds
perceptual_protocol.not_a_proof: Sparse frames can miss temporal offsets, crops, reuploads, overlays and unenumerated histories. Similar scenes can false-positive. No clean-quality verdict or calibration/test eligibility follows.
perceptual_protocol.phash: 63 AC bits from top-left8x8 DCT of gray32x32; strict above median; bit index is flattened AC position
perceptual_protocol.scope: candidate-candidate and candidate-versus-enumerated-Stage7 sources only; prior sparse32 thumbnail hashes not treated as compatible with this decoder/positions
perceptual_protocol.selection: first decoded presentation timestamp at or after requested timestamp; backward keyframe seek then normal decode

required_before_qualification: Resolve any exact/perceptual duplicate flags by source-only manual review; source-group all confirmed reuploads/excerpts together.
Verify complete deterministic 96-frame clean target window readability, timestamp and decoded pixel hashes; three sparse frames do not establish this.
Source-only visual quality review under frozen sharpness, existing compression, resampling, title/black/static and content criteria; historical bandpass gate is insufficient.
Resolve source/uploader/reupload group relationships beyond literal YouTube ID; historical unlogged aliases and upstream pretraining remain unknown.
Extend semantic/source and duplicate crosscheck to historical generated, unified and benchmark assets outside the enumerated AudioSet/Stage7 pool before stronger nonoverlap claims.
Approve eligibility before any calibration/test split; current pilot dev remains tuning data.
